Get Started

FAQ

Frequently Asked Questions

Straight answers about what Reprise AI does, where we're located, what an AI implementation costs, and what kind of return to expect.

What does Reprise AI do?

Reprise AI is an AI consulting and implementation agency based in Tampa, Florida. We design, build, and deploy custom AI Operating Systems for businesses with proven operational logic — voice agents, chat agents, RAG pipelines, workflow automation, and integrations into CRMs, phone systems, and scheduling platforms. We don't sell software subscriptions. We ship production systems that clients own outright.

Where is Reprise AI located?

Reprise AI is headquartered in Tampa, Florida, and serves clients across the Tampa Bay region and nationwide. The team operates remotely-first, with on-site engagements available throughout the Southeast United States.

What industries does Reprise AI work with?

We're industry agnostic. We've delivered production AI implementations across home services (HVAC, plumbing, electrical), healthcare (dental and med-spa groups), real estate, professional services (insurance, legal, accounting), and e-commerce. The common thread isn't industry — it's whether a business has clear operational logic that can be encoded into an AI system.

How long does a typical implementation take?

Most engagements ship to production in 60 to 90 days from kickoff. Time-sensitive projects with narrower scope have launched in as little as two weeks. We use a phased rollout to minimize disruption — discovery and design in weeks 1–3, build in weeks 4–8, and validation plus go-live in weeks 9–12.

How much does an AI implementation cost?

Implementation costs typically range from $15,000 for a focused single-workflow build to $150,000 or more for full multi-system AI Operating Systems. Most engagements fall between $25,000 and $75,000. Pricing is fixed-scope and outcome-based — we price against the projected business impact of the system, not against billed hours.

Do clients own the code Reprise AI builds?

Yes. Every engagement transfers 100% ownership of the code, infrastructure, and integrations to the client at delivery. There are no vendor lock-ins, no recurring platform fees, and no proprietary systems that hold your data hostage. If you ever want to operate the system without us, you can — that's by design.

What’s an "AI Operating System"?

An AI Operating System is the production-grade runtime layer that powers all of a business’s AI agents and automations. It has five layers: a Data Foundation (cleaned, queryable knowledge), an Intelligence Engine (the models and prompts), an Orchestration Layer (the workflows that route work between agents and humans), an Integration Framework (connections to your CRM, phone system, and tools), and a Command Center (the dashboard where you observe and adjust the system).

We deploy this same five-layer architecture for every client, then customize each layer to the specific business.

How is Reprise AI different from off-the-shelf AI SaaS products?

Off-the-shelf AI SaaS products are built for a generalized average customer — they're configurable, not custom. They can't encode the specific operational logic that makes your business work, and you pay platform fees in perpetuity for software you don't own.

Reprise AI builds custom AI Operating Systems against your actual workflows, integrates them into your existing tools, and transfers full ownership at delivery. The result is a system that fits your business instead of forcing your business to fit the software.

Does Reprise AI work with companies outside Tampa Bay?

Yes. While Reprise AI is headquartered in Tampa, Florida, the majority of our engagements are with clients outside the Tampa Bay region. We work remotely-first and have delivered AI Operating Systems for clients across the United States.

What's the typical ROI from a Reprise AI engagement?

Across 30+ completed implementations, the average return in year one is approximately $600,000 in net new revenue or recovered cost — measured against an average implementation cost of $25,000 to $75,000. Most clients reach payback within three to five months of go-live. We define ROI targets during discovery and track them in the Command Center from launch, and continue iterating until those targets are hit.

Still have questions?

Book a 30-minute discovery call and we'll walk through your specific situation, map out where AI creates ROI in your business, and give you a fixed-scope implementation plan.
